# Gobiya

> Los Angeles SEO agency for technical SEO, AI search (GEO), content and paid media. We fix what stops Google and AI assistants finding you — and prove it in GSC.

Gobiya is a search practice based in Los Angeles, CA, founded in 2019.
Engagements open with a reproducible forensic audit — server logs, render diffs, index coverage,
and AI citation traces — and structural repairs ship before growth work.

Contact: hello@gobiya.com · (323) 744-1338

## Services

- [Local & Technical SEO](https://www.gobiya.com/services/technical-seo): Picture your site showing up first and staying there. Los Angeles technical SEO that clears the crawl errors, speed and schema gaps holding you back.
- [AI & GEO Search](https://www.gobiya.com/services/geo): Picture ChatGPT naming your business first. Los Angeles GEO that structures your pages so AI assistants can quote you and credit you by name.
- [Content Strategy](https://www.gobiya.com/services/content-marketing): Picture a page you published last year still bringing in customers today. Los Angeles content marketing built on real search intent, not filler.
- [Digital PR & Link Building](https://www.gobiya.com/services/link-building): Expert Digital PR & Link Building services for dominating search results with backlinks your competitors can't buy. Real editorial coverage that builds true authority.
- [PPC & Lead Generation](https://www.gobiya.com/services/ppc): Picture every ad dollar landing on someone ready to buy. Los Angeles PPC management that cuts the wasted spend and tracks real cost per lead.
- [CRO & Optimization](https://www.gobiya.com/services/cro): Data-driven CRO & UX Analysis for converting your existing traffic into a predictable revenue stream. Find the friction, test the fix and lift conversions.
- [Web UX & Interface Design](https://www.gobiya.com/services/web-ux): Expert Web UX & Interface Design creating an effortless user experience that keeps visitors engaged and buying. Mobile-first, accessible and effortless.
- [Web Design & Development](https://www.gobiya.com/services/web-dev): Professional Web & App Development delivering a website that ranks on day one and turns traffic into revenue. Fast, search-ready and built to bring in leads.
- [AI Systems & Consulting](https://www.gobiya.com/services/ai-consulting): Strategic AI & LLM Systems Consulting focused on putting your business busywork on autopilot to free up your team. Automate real work efficiently.
